pi.frontmatter:
name: prd-to-task
description: >-
  Turn a PRD into an executable task-<feature>.md: settle the visual skeleton (layering, who scrolls, fixed bars, card order) before any per-control table; challenge the change boundary with codegraph (change / add / forbid rows with blast radius); enumerate every element and icon source (Figma node-id, existing asset, or needs-new; never a lookalike); map every backend status value to visuals and tappability; fill 11 required tables (interaction matrix, permission and quota, enums, API failure and degradation, partial responses, identifiers, request budget, callback timeouts, new abstraction contract) plus a per-block visual spec; events in tracking-doc-format layout inside the same document; bilingual copy. Missing information stays pending with a blocking level and owner: never infer, never confirm. At most 3 questions per round and 15 rounds per feature point, rendered as four bold lines Question / Evidence / Suggested / Options. Dump every Figma node once into docs/<feature>/nodes.tsv; land assets in the same round (compare bytes only, PNG from rawImages@3x, never a flattened export); before writing, run validate_task_doc.py and check_assets.sh and paste the output - 0 fail is the only path to executable. The implementation round starts by running the same scripts and reporting W/I per visual-spec block. Use when importing a PRD, splitting requirements, supplementing a task doc, or asking whether an implementation matches the doc.
